title: Don't Open the Door
prompt: A little girl was warned by her parents never to open the cellar door. If she did, she would see things they did not want her to see. One day, while her parents were out, they accidentally left the cellar door unlocked. The girl opened it. What did she see?
solution: When the girl opened the cellar door she saw the living room and, through its windows, a beautiful garden. She had never seen these before because her parents had kept her in the cellar all her life.
